claims.statement: The rendered control is named by its visible label.
An error state marks the control invalid and renders an alert associated with the field.
Adding help or error text does not replace or remove the control element.

component.purpose: Binds field labels, controls, descriptions, and errors into one stable accessible relationship.
component.title: FormField

states.description: A field with label and optional description.
A field with an associated recoverable error.
